Online Poll
Poll: Should the state do more to notify owners of unclaimed property?
The 9th Circuit Court of Appeals gave the go-ahead to two people who want to sue the Arizona Department of Revenue for violating their due process rights by not doing enough to notify them of money or other property listed as "unclaimed'' or "abandoned.'' State law requires that the agency operate a website listing the unclaimed property but doesn’t require actual notice to the apparent owner. Should the state do more to notify owners of unclaimed property? Or should it be up to the owners to find unclaimed property that might be belong to them?
